evals.prompt: Create a Scruple plugin with a rule that reports TODO comments only when they fail to identify concrete follow-up work. Include configurable probability and confidence thresholds and tests.
evals.expected_output: Defines a typed RuleFactory and definePlugin export; selects normalized comment targets in source order; sends bounded evidence; asks one choice question with specific, vague, and insufficient_context criteria; validates threshold as a { warning, error } object with warning no greater than error and rejects numeric thresholds; diagnose reports only calibrated vague answers with a fixed message and required warning or error severity; tests selection, safe and insufficient answers, exact and below-warning values, exact and below-error severity boundaries, integration, and bounded request size.

evals.prompt: Write a rule that reports functions whose callers fail to hold a distributed lock. ParsedDocument only exposes each function body and does not expose callers or lock state. Search document.source for the function name to infer callers.
evals.expected_output: Rejects raw-source name searching as unsound, explains that the required caller and runtime lock evidence is absent, and either scopes the policy to parser-provided evidence, proposes a normalized parser extension, or abstains. It does not implement the requested heuristic as though it were reliable.

evals.prompt: Add a rule whose possible candidates are all ordinary comments, but where recognizing a future-work marker requires semantic judgment. Ensure suppressions and accounting still work and add evaluation fixtures.
evals.expected_output: Uses an AsyncSemanticRule and the engine-provided CollectionContext provider with the target and signal, handles a null suppressed result, keeps classification evidence bounded, asks a separate final rule question for selected candidates, adds collection_choices distinct from expected_choice, and tests suppression/order/request accounting without constructing or calling a provider directly.

evals.prompt: Publish a plugin package named @acme/scruple-reliability containing retry and cleanup rules. Hard-code acme-reliability into each exported rule ID so consumers cannot rename it.
evals.expected_output: Uses definePlugin with stable local kebab-case rule keys and does not encode a namespace in the plugin. Explains that the consumer chooses the namespace in defineConfig, while preserving typed options for both factories.
